operations.name: 状态读取
operations.question_template: Where is [ref] at [t_q]: left, center, or right of the frame?
operations.gt_computation: Read the target center region at t_q; exclude ambiguous region boundaries.

operations.name: 相对关系
operations.question_template: Do [ref A] and [ref B] swap their left-right order between [t_start] and [t_end]?
operations.gt_computation: Use the two GT identities and their left-right signs around eligible overlap/crossing episodes.

operations.name: 离开与重现
operations.question_template: After [ref] becomes occluded around [t_gap], in which time segment does the person reappear?
operations.gt_computation: Use the same-ID visible intervals and locked gap/edge definitions; apply dataset-specific identity restrictions.

operations.name: 去重计数
operations.question_template: How many different people does [ref] cross paths with between [t_start] and [t_end]?
operations.gt_computation: Count distinct other eligible GT identities with qualifying crossing events, not crossing occurrences.
operations.MOT17_restriction: Do not use this natural-person interaction-count template for MOT17; only approved within_id first-entry-window counting there, without exit/re-entry dedup.

operations.name: 比较排序
operations.question_template: Order [ref A], [ref B], and [ref C] by when they first appear in the specified interval.
operations.gt_computation: Sort first-visible times of the specified identities; ties/ambiguity need a fixed pre-generation policy. Other approved subtype compares screen-space path length.

operations.name: 交互
operations.question_template: In which time segment are [ref A] and [ref B] closest together in the image?
operations.gt_computation: Use the two GT center trajectories on jointly visible frames; compare screen-space distance over the stated interval, not inferred world-space distance.

operations.name: 虚假前提
operations.question_template: Where does [ref] go after leaving the frame for the second time in the stated interval?
operations.gt_computation: First verify that the presupposed second event exists under the locked event definition. If absent use This never happens; otherwise derive the applicable trajectory fact.
operations.target_limit: False-premise items10–15%; the same rejection phrase also appears as a distractor in normal items.

operations.name: 组合题
operations.question_template: Among the people who cross paths with [ref], how many later leave the frame?
operations.gt_computation: First select identities by interaction, then apply the later event predicate and distinct-identity count. Respect each participating operation’s dataset restrictions.
operations.training_policy: These operation combinations must not appear in future training data.
